verifiedFacts: Kickoff 24 July 2026, 20:00 local Austrian time at Raiffeisen Arena, Linz.
Match is the third edition of the Summer Series Upper Austria, organized by Match PR and hosted by LASK.
Article frames the friendly as a high-profile pre-season test following Monza's promotion to Serie A.
Italy broadcast: Sportitalia (digital terrestrial channel 60, plus website/app).
Confirms this is Monza's second pre-season match under Ivan Jurić, after the 4-3 win over Pro Vercelli.
Monza 4-3 Pro Vercelli, played 18 July 2026 at Centro Sportivo Silvio e Luigi Berlusconi-Monzello, Monza's first pre-season friendly under Jurić after ten days of training.

Goals: 7' Burruano (Pro Vercelli), 11' own goal by Van Koeverden (credited to Monza, from a Birindelli/Mota cross), 17' Colpani (Monza), 49' Rutigliano (Pro Vercelli), 57' Forson (Monza), 79' Petagna (Monza), 84' Comi (Pro Vercelli).
Multiple substitutions made at half-time; no formation or full starting XI published.
Article explicitly names the Galatasaray match on 24 July in Linz as Monza's next fixture.
Ivan Jurić appointed AC Monza head coach effective 1 July 2026.

Managerial background: Mantova (Serie C, 2014-15 debut), historic first promotion to Serie A with Crotone (2016), then Genoa, Hellas Verona, Torino, Roma, Southampton, Atalanta (UEFA Champions League debut).
Official description: 'a coach renowned for his charisma, experience, intensity and bold, aggressive style of football'; Verona spell cited for an attacking style that won over fans.
No contract-length details published.
Serie B play-off final second leg: Catanzaro 2-0 Monza (29 May 2026, U-Power Stadium, attendance record 17,015).
Monza had won the first leg 2-0 and finished higher in the regular-season table, so advanced to Serie A on aggregate/standing despite the second-leg loss.
Goals conceded to Jack (39') and Frosinini (78'); head coach at the time was Paolo Bianco, not Jurić — Jurić was appointed over a month later for the new Serie A campaign.
Homepage confirms the Galatasaray friendly (24 July, 20:00, Raiffeisen Arena, live on Sportitalia) as the featured upcoming fixture.
Summer transfer activity: Ricardo Mangas signed (in); Luca Ravanelli transferred to Sampdoria (out).
No matchday squad list for the Galatasaray friendly published as of the access date.
S Sport Plus holds exclusive Turkey broadcast rights for the match.
Confirms kickoff 21:00 Turkey time, Raiffeisen Arena (Linz, Austria), Summer Series Upper Austria.

Galatasaray's Austria training camp runs 23-29 July in Windischgarsten.
Confirms further pre-season fixtures: Venezia (27 July, Hofmann Personal Stadium), Rennes (2 August, RAMS Park), Villarreal (8 August, RAMS Park).

strengthSignals: Colpani, Forson and Petagna all scored in the first Jurić friendly — an early, if single-match, sign of attacking output under the new system.

Official club description of Jurić's approach ('intensity and bold, aggressive style') suggests a high-press, transition-based game plan that has troubled possession-based sides before.

sourceConflicts.description: The AA (Anadolu Ajansı) article summary returned the match date as '25 Temmuz 2026 (Cuma)', but 25 July 2026 is a Saturday, not a Friday — internally inconsistent. AC Monza's own official announcement, S Sport Plus, and the Monza-Pro Vercelli match report (which names the Galatasaray game as Monza's 'next fixture') all independently agree on Friday, 24 July 2026. Resolved in favor of the official club source plus calendar arithmetic; treated as an extraction artifact in the AA summary rather than a genuine competing fact.
